text_block_list.text:
At last, Симболи Рудольф, the Emperor, is
slated to
make her racing debut.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The news spreads through the racing
world like
wildfire.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Did you see the news? We're finally
going to see
Симболи Рудольф race!
text_block_list.name: Passerby A

text_block_list.text:
I totally did! I hear she's super strong. I
can't wait!
text_block_list.name: Passerby B

text_block_list.text:
It may be early, but expectations are
high for the
Emperor. Would it be fair to
say that the Classic
Triple Crown is a
shoe-in?
text_block_list.name: Репортёр A

text_block_list.text:
It certainly would! The real question is,
how far
can she go from there? This is
one heck of a
story, and we'll be there
every step of the way
with the hottest
scoops!
text_block_list.name: Репортёр B

text_block_list.text:
Have you seen those reporters outside? I
bet
they're all here for the president.
text_block_list.name: Student A

text_block_list.text:
And she's only just announced her
debut... Only
President Rudolf could
pull that off.
text_block_list.name: Student B

text_block_list.text:
Right? That's our ace for you. I wanna be
just like
her someday...
text_block_list.name: Student C

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we follow her, we can't go
wrong!
text_block_list.name: Student A

text_block_list.text:
Both inside and outside of the academy,
it seems
like the Emperor is all anybody
can talk about.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And as the expectations mount and
pressure
builds, the Umamusume of the
hour...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Good morning, everyone. You're all
bright-eyed
and bushy-tailed today, I
see.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...seems completely unperturbed.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ah! Good morning, President!
text_block_list.name: Student A

text_block_list.text:
We're really sorry! We shouldn't have
been
talking behind your back!
text_block_list.name: Student B

text_block_list.text:
It's quite all right. If anything, what you
said was
rather flattering.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you follow me, you can't go wrong... If
that is
truly how you feel, then I couldn't
be more
satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Rest assured, I won't betray your trust.
You have
my word that I will lead you
straight and true.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I only ask that you continue to place
your faith in
me. Can you do that?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: O-of course!
text_block_list.name: Students

text_block_list.text: I'm pleased to hear it.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now then. Trainer, I have kept you
waiting long
enough. Shall we?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I have something to say. Would
you
hear me out?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We're getting ready for my debut race,
but it
goes without saying that my sights
are set far
higher.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
My true goal is to create a world in
which all
Umamusume can live in bliss.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But such a paradise won't come about on
its own.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Since the dawn of time, people have
attempted
to change the world for the
better. And time after
time, they have
chosen the same method.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Namely, to install an exceptional leader
who can
guide the masses. Every nation
in every age has
come to this same
conclusion.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And the one to guide the Umamusume
through
the pain and strife of the racing
world...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: ...will be me, Симболи Рудольф.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
That being said, I am yet a novice. My
voice holds
no more weight than a
whisper in the wind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thus, my first task is to prove myself an

Emperor—a ruler whose strength no one
can deny.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But how can an Emperor show that she is
worthy
of her place?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Let me give you a hint. It is something
one wears
on their head. Or does that
make it too simple?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Precisely. A crown is a clear and visible
symbol of
might and majesty.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And what crown better suits an
Umamusume than
one bestowed on
victors on the track?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby,
and the
Kikuka Sho—the Classic Triple
Crown.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
To claim these titles is the least I must

accomplish. I will do so at any cost.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But I will not stop there. I swear I will
work myself
to the bone to claim future
victories.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: So I must ask you...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Are you prepared to join me in pursuit of
this
grand and foolhardy dream?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Her eyes bore straight into me, telling
me in no
uncertain terms that
half-hearted resolve won't
cut it here.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her goal is far too lofty and her burden
far too
weighty for one person to bear
alone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's all the more reason I want to help
her on
her journey. Ever since the day
she first chose me,
I've been ready for
this!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ha! A fine reply.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I know you won't let
me
down.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Now, then. That's quite enough serious
talk, don't
you think?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
There's another reason I called you here
today. I
don't suppose you like coffee?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We'll have few opportunities to talk at
length
after my debut, so we ought
make the most of the
time we have now.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What say we discuss things in more
detail over an
aromatic cup of coffee?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We will still have to watch the time, of
course. I
wouldn't want to stay out too...
latte.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Get it? Latte? Late? Hmmm, perhaps
that was a
little forced...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
...And so Симболи Рудольф and I embark
on our
grand endeavor!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
